claims.nodeLabel: 1975 SAC Nuclear-Base Overflights (Loring, Wurtsmith, Malmstrom, Minot)
claims.sourceText: National Military Command Center Memorandum for the Record, 8 November 1975
claims.text: The NMCC Memorandum for the Record of 8 November 1975, subject 'Unidentified Sightings', records seven height-finder radar cuts at Malmstrom at 0253 EST between 9,500 and 15,500 feet, simultaneous ground observation of lights and jet noise, FAA cross-tell showing no jet aircraft within 100 NM, and two F-106s scrambled at 0254 EST and airborne at 0257 EST; at 0344 EST the objects could not be intercepted.

title: National Military Command Center Memorandum for the Record

topics.title: The 1975 overflights of Strategic Air Command bases
